baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root ك ذ ب occurs in both the form-II verb at word 1 and the emphatic accusative at word 3, enclosing بِآيَاتِنَا as the object of denial.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch of declaring a thing false is applied to ء ي ي as a visible sign. Repeating the denial root turns the clause from a bare absence of belief into an active and emphatic counterverdict upon something presented as manifest.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a thing or its bearer false supplies the active verdict, while the root's two positions give that verdict emphatic force.
The visible-mark image makes the denied object manifest and readable rather than merely an abstract proposition.

changed_reading.before: They did not believe Our verses.
changed_reading.after: They actively and emphatically pronounce manifest divine signs false, turning nonacceptance into a sustained counterverdict.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The form-II denial takes آياتنا as its marked target, and the ء ي ي inventory includes deliberately aiming at a person's sign or identifying mark.
baseline_models.mechanism: The aiming-at-a-mark branch cross-lights the declaration-of-falsehood branch. Denial can therefore be carried as targeted anti-recognition: the signs are noticed well enough to be selected and then deliberately negated.

activation_trace.role: The declaring-false image supplies the deliberate negative judgment imposed on the selected object.
Aiming at a person's mark supplies intentional targeting and turns missed recognition into anti-recognition.

changed_reading.after: They deliberately take the identifying marks themselves as targets and negate what those marks identify.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus repeats ك ذ ب around visible signs, while one focus branch describes a charge as false when it is not carried through.
baseline_models.mechanism: The signs can be heard as posing a practical charge, and the branch of a charge failing to prove true makes denial performative as well as verbal. Their conduct does not carry through the response that the signs call for.

activation_trace.role: A charge that fails by not being carried through supplies the image of a demanded performance left unrealized.
The visible sign anchors the inferred demand in the focus object rather than in a free-standing moral theme.

changed_reading.before: Their error is false speech about signs.
changed_reading.after: Their denial is also a failed performance: they do not carry through the response that manifest signs demand.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening moves from reciprocal questioning about an arriving report, through divergent paths, to doubled promised disclosure. The focus denial becomes premature closure: an unsettled report is converted into an emphatic falsehood verdict before the promised knowing arrives.

activation_trace.role: The declaration-of-falsehood branch supplies the closing verdict into which the earlier dispute hardens.
Visible signs keep the revised reading anchored in the focus object of that verdict.
Mutual questioning supplies an initially open and socially circulating inquiry.
An arriving, conveyed report supplies the matter moving into the community's attention.
Each party taking a different path turns disagreement into diverging interpretive routes.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the promised resolution that the denial anticipates and forecloses.

structural_cues: 78:1-5 forms a question-report-disagreement-repeated-knowing sequence before the focus.
The doubled كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ postpones resolution beyond the disputants' present verdict.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mutual inquiry, an arriving report, divergent paths, and coming disclosure; I supply the arrow that emphatic denial is the hardening and premature closure of that sequence. A live alternative is that disagreement and denial are parallel descriptions rather than stages.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports a settled act of disbelief.
changed_reading.after: The focus catches inquiry at the point where it hardens into a preemptive verdict, declaring false what the surah says will later become known.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prepared ground, pegged fixity, sleep as cutting-off, night as covering, and vegetation emerging form an operating habitat. آياتنا now includes functional arrangements inhabited every day; falsifying them denies the intelligibility and givenness of a support system one continues to use.

activation_trace.role: Declaring false supplies the counterverdict imposed on the material system.
The visible-sign image allows the material arrangements to populate the focus plural آياتنا.
Making a thing take a condition supplies deliberate functional arrangement rather than inert inventory.
Preparing and leveling supplies the earth's enabling role in the habitat.
Peg-like upright fixity supplies stabilization within the system.
Cutting off and removal make sleep a functional interruption of activity.
Covering with a garment gives night a protective and enclosing operation.
Vegetation emerging from earth completes the water-to-life output of the arrangement.

structural_cues: 78:6-16 is a first-person-plural sequence of making, building, sending down, and bringing forth.
The purpose clause at 78:15 links rain to grain and growth, giving the inventory causal direction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preparation, fixity, interruption, covering, and emergence; I group these operations into one inhabited support system and map that system into the focus plural 'Our signs.' A live alternative is that the verses present independent benefactions rather than an integrated mechanism.

changed_reading.before: They deny revealed signs as items of information.
changed_reading.after: They falsify an operating habitat whose coordinated signs prepare, stabilize, rest, cover, water, and feed them even while they deny it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding absence of future-directed expectation toward reckoning removes the horizon in which signs point beyond the present. Denial becomes temporal foreclosure: they declare the signs false because they do not let an account become a live future.

activation_trace.role: The falsehood verdict is the focus action explained by the lost future horizon.
Visible signs are the present marks whose forward reference is being closed.
The heart's orientation toward what is awaited supplies the future-directed posture explicitly negated here.
Counting and accounting specify the future event from which their expectation is withdrawn.

structural_cues: 78:27 immediately precedes the focus and negates their expectation of an account.
The plural subject continues from إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا through وَكَذَّبُوا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies no expected accounting followed by emphatic denial; I supply the causal arrow that refusing a future account disables the signs' forward reference. A live alternative is that the two are coordinated traits with no causal priority.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a judgment made after considering present evidence.
changed_reading.after: Denial is also a temporal posture: by refusing to anticipate accounting, they prevent present signs from pointing into an accountable future.

context_deltas.mechanism: A corresponding recompense precedes the focus and an imperative to taste follows it. The intensive denial is therefore not only followed by punishment; its repeated shape enters a measure-for-measure process that converts a verbal counterclaim into experienced consequence.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood in speech or action supplies the patterned conduct answered by recompense.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the return path from conduct to consequence.
A measure equal to its counterpart supplies calibration rather than arbitrary sequence.
Experiencing and undergoing a thing turns the earlier verbal denial into personally tested outcome.

structural_cues: 78:26 labels the preceding punishment جَزَاءً وِفَاقًا, while 78:30 commands tasting after the focus and record.
The focus's intensive كِذَّابًا supplies a degree and pattern capable of being answered congruently.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recompense, counterpart measure, and experiential tasting; I infer that the intensive denial is a calibrated input to that sequence. A live alternative is that correspondence measures the group's whole conduct rather than this act's intensity specifically.

changed_reading.after: The denial's emphatic pattern is answered by a fitted consequence that makes the reality they verbally rejected into something they must experience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's attempt to negate signs is immediately followed by totality, exhaustive counting, and writing that establishes a binding record. The act of erasure becomes an entry: declaring signs false cannot remove them or the declaration from the account.

activation_trace.role: Declaring the signs false supplies the attempted negation that the record absorbs.
Visible marks supply what the denial tries to cancel from recognition.
Comprehensive totality closes any gap through which the denial could escape registration.
Exhaustive numerical reckoning supplies complete preservation of particulars.
Writing that establishes a judgment or decree makes the preserved account binding.

structural_cues: 78:29 immediately follows the focus with وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَاهُ كِتَابًا.
The adjacent accusatives كِذَّابًا and كِتَابًا sharpen the reversal from negating to inscribing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies totality, exhaustive count, and binding writing; I supply the arrow that the record functions as counter-memory to denial's attempted erasure. A live alternative is that 78:29 records deeds generally without targeting the logic of denial.

changed_reading.before: They try to cancel the truth-value of the signs.
changed_reading.after: Their cancellation attempt is itself uncancelled: it is exhaustively counted and fixed in the record beside the signs it could not erase.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closed sky opens, stable mountains are displaced, and their apparent solidity resolves into shining mirage. The signs are not static tokens but disclosures of reversibility; denial mistakes the present surface of the world for its final state.

activation_trace.role: The falsehood verdict supplies the fixed judgment imposed on a world whose surfaces are about to reverse.
Visible signs anchor the model in what can be read from changing appearances.
A closed thing opening into a widened entry supplies reversal of the sky's apparent boundary.
Removal and displacement undo the mountains' prior image of fixed stability.
A mirage shining like water supplies the terminal mismatch between appearance and material state.

structural_cues: Mountains appear as pegs at 78:7 and recur as displaced mirage at 78:20.
78:17-20 moves from appointed separation to collective arrival, opened sky, and transformed mountains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening, displacement, mirage, and the mountain reversal; I infer that these events teach the provisionality of present surfaces and thereby revise what counts as a sign. A live alternative is that they are only future events, not commentary on the denial's perceptual mistake.

changed_reading.before: They deny static signs placed before them.
changed_reading.after: They deny signs whose very mechanism reveals that apparently fixed surfaces are provisional and will be opened, moved, and exposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later reward scene negates hearing both empty speech and another occurrence of ك ذ ب. The focus denial thus becomes a pollutant in a shared acoustic world, while reward includes a social environment from which false and futile speech has been removed.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood in speech or action supplies the harmful verbal production echoed later under negation.
Auditory perception makes the later condition an acoustic and communal environment, not only an inward state.
Vain and ugly speech supplies the neighboring class of verbal pollution excluded from that environment.

structural_cues: 78:35 repeats ك ذ ب at word 6 but negates its audibility alongside لَغْوًا.
The focus uses an intensive denial noun; the later verse turns the same root-class into something absent from communal hearing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hearing, vain speech, and exact root recurrence; I infer that judgment answers denial partly by purifying the shared speech environment. A live alternative is that the later كِذَّابًا means mutual lying generally and does not point specifically back to 78:28.

changed_reading.before: Denial is an individual's mistaken proposition.
changed_reading.after: Denial is also socially produced noise, and the contrasting reward is a world in which that falsifying speech no longer circulates or reaches another ear.

context_deltas.mechanism: At judgment no one owns the capacity for address; speech occurs only by permission and must settle on the side of right as the day stands fixed against falsehood. The focus denial is therefore an unauthorized counter-speech act that claims jurisdiction over divine signs.

activation_trace.role: Declaring something false supplies the counter-speech act whose authority is later stripped away.
Visible divine signs specify the object over which the speakers presume to issue judgment.
Ownership and disposal supply the capacity explicitly denied over address.
Formal exchange of speech identifies the jurisdictional medium no one independently controls.
Permission and authorization supply the condition under which speech may occur.
Right settling opposite error supplies the required reality-fitting quality of permitted speech.
Truth fixed in correspondence with reality supplies the final standard against the focus counterverdict.

structural_cues: 78:37-39 progresses from no ownership of address, through permission and right speech, to declaration of the true day.
The focus itself is a transitive verdict over 'Our signs,' so the later control of speech directly revises its social force.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied ownership of address, licensed speech, rightness, and reality-matching truth; I infer that the earlier denial usurps a verdict-authority the speakers do not possess. A live alternative is that the judgment scene regulates eschatological decorum without retroactively characterizing the earlier denial.

changed_reading.before: They make a factually wrong statement about signs.
changed_reading.after: They presume to issue an unauthorized ruling over divine signs; the final scene exposes both the false content and the borrowed authority of that ruling.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final person directs sight toward what the hands sent ahead, while the disbeliever is named through a root of covering truth. The focus denial becomes an authored output rather than a private opinion: a deed made and advanced by the self, then exposed for inspection.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood in both speech and action allows the focus act to enter the final inventory of deeds.
Directed sight or insight supplies the final inspection that replaces prior refusal to read signs.
Advancing something forward supplies the temporal path by which a deed arrives before its maker.
What the two hands earn supplies personal production and responsibility for the inspected output.
Covering truth supplies the final actor-description that links concealment to the earlier falsehood verdict.

structural_cues: 78:40 closes the surah with warning, inspection of what hands advanced, and the disbeliever's wish to be dust.
The movement from visible signs at the focus to directed seeing at the end reverses the earlier refusal of recognition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inspection, advance, hand-earned output, and covering truth; I place the focus denial among the products now inspected. A live alternative is that 'what his hands advanced' denotes the whole deed-record without isolating denial as a specially handmade act.

changed_reading.before: Denial is held internally or uttered and then passes away.
changed_reading.after: Denial is something the self manufactures, sends ahead, and later confronts as its own visible output.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the خ ل ق branch of fabricating falsehood from a context occurrence meaning divine creation. It remains valid as a packet-resolved cross-branch analogy anchored in the focus ك ذ ب, but downstream prose should call it a counter-making image, not claim that خَلَقْنَاكُمْ lexically means fabrication here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The emphatic ك ذ ب act produces a counterclaim against آياتنا, while the context خ ل ق inventory explicitly includes fabrication of falsehood and speech.

activation_trace.role: Declaring the signs false supplies the rival account produced by the deniers.
Visible signs keep the counter-making image attached to the focus object.
The literal branch image of fabricating falsehood or speech supplies a parasitic making set against the surah's divine making.

changed_reading.before: They deny what divine making and revelation display.
changed_reading.after: Within a surah of divine making, their denial appears as parasitic counter-making: producing a rival account of manifest signs.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it joins a deceptive patterned cloth under ك ذ ب to night as garment and ك ف ر as covering. It remains anchored in the focus denial and visible signs, but downstream prose should present it as a material analogy for obscuring appearance, not as the direct lexical sense of كِذَّابًا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus inventory gives ك ذ ب a cloth that deceives by its appearance and ء ي ي a visible mark; context supplies both garment-covering and covering truth.

activation_trace.role: A patterned cloth that deceives by its condition supplies denial as a misleading layer of appearance.
The visible mark supplies what remains present underneath the misleading layer.
Covering with a garment supplies the material operation of laying one appearance over another.
Covering and concealment carry the overlay image into the final designation of the denier.

changed_reading.before: Denial is only a spoken contradiction of signs.
changed_reading.after: Denial can be pictured as laying a deceptive covering over visible marks so that their present appearance is made to tell against what they disclose.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping from س م و to the و س م branch of a visible identifying mark. It remains resolvable and anchored in آياتنا as visible signs, but downstream prose should label it an exploratory branch activation rather than derive 'sky' etymologically from 'mark.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: آياتنا carries the visible-mark branch, and the sky named at 78:19 is both branch-activated as a mark and structurally opened.

activation_trace.role: The visible-sign image supplies the focus category into which the opened sky is experimentally mapped.
Declaring false supplies the refusal to recognize the mark when it becomes legible.
A visible impressed mark that makes a thing known supplies the exploratory image of the sky as inscribed surface.
Opening what was closed supplies the event that makes the marked surface disclose an entry.

changed_reading.before: The sky is one object among the signs they deny.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the sky becomes a marked surface whose opening makes the refused sign legible as an entry rather than a backdrop.

strongest_changes: The immediate 78:27-29 frame turns denial into temporal refusal trapped between an unanticipated account and an exhaustive record.
The created-world sequence turns آياتنا from abstract information into an operating habitat that the deniers inhabit while falsifying it.
The 78:35-39 speech sequence recasts denial as socially polluting and unauthorized counter-speech, contrasted with permitted reality-fitting speech.
The final inspection at 78:40 makes denial an authored deed sent ahead and exposed to its maker.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet did not force one final interpretation: material support, temporal foreclosure, forensic recording, speech authority, and perceptual reversal all changed the same focus construction by distinct anchored mechanisms. Exact root recurrence and split-root branch images also preserved several contained readings that a conservative synthesis would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The intensive force of كِذَّابًا may emphasize degree, recurrence, or the cognate act without selecting only one nuance.
The causal arrow from not expecting an account to denying signs remains inferential; the traits may instead be parallel.
The exact scope of ك ذ ب at 78:35 may be false speech generally or mutual denial rather than a direct echo of 78:28.
The counter-creation, deceptive-covering, and opened-mark outliers depend on deliberately branch-distant analogies and should remain qualified.
